overview: Based on the published agenda, this special Village Board meeting was scheduled to address the acceptance of the Village Clerk's resignation. The meeting represented an urgent personnel matter requiring immediate board action.

discussions.body: The board was scheduled to consider and vote on the acceptance of the Village Clerk's resignation. This personnel matter was the primary focus of the special meeting called for August 27, 2026.

publicComment: Public comment was on the agenda, limited to 15 minutes total with three minutes per person at the Chief Presiding Officer's discretion.
actionItems: Scheduled to vote on acceptance of Village Clerk's resignation
title: Special Village Board Meeting - 2026-08-27
